messages:
alex: Heads-up: multiple SEV1 pagers failed to go out. incident-bot logs show 502 from notify-webhook. Anyone oncall?
incident-bot: Warning: outbound webhook 502. Suppressed pages=4. Logs -> /var/log/notify-webhook/2026-03-17.log
priya: I'm oncall. Are pages queued or lost?
alex: Looks like webhook proxy TLS handshake failing; cert expired on proxy host. curl -> `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway`.
jamie: I can rotate the cert on proxy now. @noah can you escalate to PD manually for the impacted customers?
noah: On it. Triggered PD manual pages for 3 customers. PD IDs: PD-9876, PD-9877, PD-9878
priya: Thanks. Also the incident channel autosummary set sev=P2 because the channel parser dropped `urgency` tag. Parser changed shape after the webhook error.
alex: Workaround: disabled suppressor for notify-webhook and restarted the proxy: `sudo systemctl restart notify-proxy` — testing now.
incident-bot: notify-proxy health check failing -> fallback relay attempted: relay-2 returned 503.
jamie: Rolling cert now. ETA ~5m. Priya, can you update the status page? Use template /ops/status-templates/paging-failure.md
priya: Posting status update now: https://status.example.com/incidents/3419876500
noah: PD confirms manual pages delivered to oncall, customers being contacted. Will update PD incidents.
alex: Cert rotated, proxy back healthy. Sample log: ```2026-03-17T02:08:05Z notify-proxy INFO TLS handshake success, cert valid until 2027-04-02``` 
incident-bot: Suppressed pages cleared; queued pages forwarded (3 delivered).
jamie: Can customers confirm they got pages?
noah: Customer A confirmed, Customer B pending callback, Customer C acknowledged. Updating PD entries.
priya: Follow-up: create cert-expiry monitor + parser contract tests + ensure suppressor fail-open. Assigning to @jamie
jamie: Will own cert monitor + parser tests. Opening follow-up ticket INC-4321.
alex: Retro draft: root cause = expired proxy cert + suppressor masking outbound failures + channel parser drop causing severity mislabel. Impact ~5-12m. Next actions: cert monitor, healthcheck for relay, fail-open suppressor, parser regression tests.
incident-bot: Incident closed by priya. Duration 00:12. Tags: paging, webhook, tls, suppressor, followup
